name: Kirkland Signature Supreme Cauliflower Crust Pizza (FODMAP Warning)
whyItWorks: While marketed as healthy and gluten-free, cauliflower is extremely high in sulfur-containing glucosinolates and FODMAP polyols that cause massive bloating and severe gas pains in IBD patients, compounded by pepperoni and cheese.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Severe Gas & Bloating Hazard: Do not assume cauliflower crust is gut-friendly. Choose a regular thin white flour crust instead.
